source.identity: March 3, 1994 EPA Explanation of Significant Differences with the June 11, 1993 MDNR Fall 1992 Cadillac Area Groundwater Investigation memorandum and supporting tables.
source.reconciliation: Byte-identical to the canonical site record 095-b7620af87938. No duplicate catalog card or second binary was created.

reviewCoverage.textCoverage: Embedded text was checked for all pages; maps, dense analytical tables, handwriting and the signature page were verified against rendered page images.

supportedFindings.finding: EPA finally concluded that North Park and West of Leeson groundwater contamination was commingled with contamination at the Northernaire/Kysor site and included both areas in the remedial action.
supportedFindings.boundary: The determination concerns the historical Superfund VOC/chromium remedy area; it is not PFAS evidence or a present-day plume map.

supportedFindings.finding: MDNR reported a continuous TCE-contaminated zone more than 1,100 feet across from Sixth Avenue to the west side of the Catholic church parking lot, based on the listed North Park wells and vertical profiling.
supportedFindings.boundary: This is the memorandum's interpretation of 1992 and earlier sampling; it does not establish current extent.

supportedFindings.finding: MDNR reported an unbroken contaminated profile more than 1,200 feet long across the West of Leeson study line and described TCE detections in CMS-3, MW-21 and MW-23.
supportedFindings.boundary: The record does not connect this historical VOC profile to Plett Road or to PFAS.

supportedFindings.finding: Table 2 preserves Fall 1992 well-specific depth and results for TCE, 1,1,1-TCA, 1,1-DCE and PCE, including multiple depth intervals for MW-20 through MW-24.
supportedFindings.boundary: Zeros and detections are reported as printed; no modern cleanup comparison or independent reanalysis was inferred.

leads.target: September 4, 1992 EPA letter that temporarily excluded North Park and West of Leeson pending future data
leads.status: referenced but not attached as a separate record in this PDF
